record.question: At the Safaigiri 2019 organized by the India Today group, who was awarded "The most effective Swachhata Ambassador"?
record.explanation: Answer B: Sachin Tendulkar. India Today Group’s 2019 Safaigiri award listing names Sachin Tendulkar as the winner in “Most Effective Swachhata Ambassador.” Reference: https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/safaigiri-awards-2019-full-list-of-winners-1605649-2019-10-02; https://specials.indiatoday.com/specials/swachh-bharat2019/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
